subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): expose anonymous Talk activity to plugins

question: Should passive Talk activity be globally observable by every plugin, or must `runtime.talk.watch` require an explicit owner/session scope or capability grant?
rationale: The code can mechanically enforce either model, but choosing which plugins may learn cross-session Talk timing and state is a product trust-boundary decision.

options.title: Require scoped authorization
options.body: Bind watchers to the caller's owned Talk session or a narrowly granted capability so unrelated plugins cannot observe other users' Talk activity.

options.title: Approve global observation
options.body: Deliberately treat anonymous Talk activity as public to all in-process plugins and document that trust model as a permanent Plugin SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Require scoped authorization
recommendation.body: Bind watchers to the caller's owned Talk session or a narrowly granted capability so unrelated plugins cannot observe other users' Talk activity.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and proposed Talk/Plugin SDK work makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the ownership decision.
